description: Start a site audit (SEO, content-quality and technical issues). repeat:true = monthly recurring audit in Frase; never schedule it yourself. Async: poll get_job_status with the returned id.

repeat.description: Monthly recurring audit in Frase: this run is run 1, the next a month later, owner emailed. One page: selected_page_urls:[url], its own scope beside other monthly audits; a whole-site repeat replaces the live whole-site one. Stop via audit_repeats.

type.description: Default full; section for path-scoped audits.

name: start_audit
